description.en: Practice introducing yourself and asking simple questions to a new friend.
description.ru: Потренируйся представляться и задавать простые вопросы новому другу.
description.vi: Luyện tập tự giới thiệu và hỏi những câu đơn giản với một người bạn mới.

steps.say: Hi there! I'm so happy to see you. What's your name?

hint.en: Say: My name is …
hint.ru: Скажи: My name is …
hint.vi: Hãy nói: My name is …

steps.good: Nice to meet you! That's a lovely name.

steps.say: How old are you?

hint.en: Say: I am … years old
hint.ru: Скажи: I am … years old
hint.vi: Hãy nói: I am … years old

steps.good: Cool, that's a great age to learn English!

steps.say: Where are you from?

hint.en: Say: I am from … (your country)
hint.ru: Скажи: I am from … (твоя страна)
hint.vi: Hãy nói: I am from … (đất nước của bạn)

steps.good: Awesome! I'd love to visit there someday.

steps.say: What do you like to do for fun?

hint.en: Say: I like … (a hobby)
hint.ru: Скажи: I like … (твоё хобби)
hint.vi: Hãy nói: I like … (một sở thích)

steps.good: That sounds like a lot of fun!

steps.say: It was great talking to you. Can we be friends?

hint.en: Say: Yes, of course! or Sure, let's be friends
hint.ru: Скажи: Yes, of course! или Sure, let's be friends
hint.vi: Hãy nói: Yes, of course! hoặc Sure, let's be friends

steps.good: Yay! I'm really glad we met today.

title.vi: Gọi đồ ở quán cà phê

description.en: Learn to order a drink and a snack politely at a café.
description.ru: Научись вежливо заказывать напиток и закуску в кафе.
description.vi: Học cách gọi đồ uống và món ăn nhẹ một cách lịch sự tại quán cà phê.

steps.say: Welcome! What would you like to drink today?

hint.en: Say: I'd like a … (drink), please
hint.ru: Скажи: I'd like a … (напиток), please
hint.vi: Hãy nói: I'd like a … (đồ uống), please

steps.good: Great choice! Coming right up.

steps.say: Would you like it hot or cold?

hint.en: Say: Hot, please or Cold, please
hint.ru: Скажи: Hot, please или Cold, please
hint.vi: Hãy nói: Hot, please hoặc Cold, please

steps.good: Perfect, I'll make it just like that.

steps.say: Do you want anything to eat with that?

hint.en: Say: Yes, a … please or No, thank you
hint.ru: Скажи: Yes, a … please или No, thank you
hint.vi: Hãy nói: Yes, a … please hoặc No, thank you

steps.good: Sounds good, I'll add that to your order.

steps.say: What size would you like — small, medium, or large?

hint.en: Say: Small, please or Medium, please
hint.ru: Скажи: Small, please или Medium, please
hint.vi: Hãy nói: Small, please hoặc Medium, please

steps.good: Got it, one size coming right up.

steps.say: That will be five pounds. Is that okay?

hint.en: Say: Yes, here you go
hint.ru: Скажи: Yes, here you go
hint.vi: Hãy nói: Yes, here you go

steps.good: Thank you! Enjoy your drink and have a great day.

description.en: Practice asking a stranger how to get somewhere in a new city.
description.ru: Потренируйся спрашивать у незнакомца, как куда-то добраться в новом городе.
description.vi: Luyện tập hỏi một người lạ cách đi đến một nơi nào đó ở thành phố mới.

steps.say: Excuse me! Are you looking for something?

hint.en: Say: Yes, I'm looking for … (a place)
hint.ru: Скажи: Yes, I'm looking for … (место)
hint.vi: Hãy nói: Yes, I'm looking for … (một nơi)

steps.good: Ah, I know that place! Let me help you.

steps.say: Do you want to go there by bus or on foot?

hint.en: Say: By bus or On foot
hint.ru: Скажи: By bus или On foot
hint.vi: Hãy nói: By bus hoặc On foot

steps.good: Good idea, that works well from here.

steps.say: Okay! Go straight and then turn left. Got it?

hint.en: Say: Yes, straight then left. Got it!
hint.ru: Скажи: Yes, straight then left. Got it!
hint.vi: Hãy nói: Yes, straight then left. Got it!

steps.good: Great, you'll find it in about five minutes.

steps.say: Is it your first time visiting this city?

hint.en: Say: Yes, it is or No, I've been here before
hint.ru: Скажи: Yes, it is или No, I've been here before
hint.vi: Hãy nói: Yes, it is hoặc No, I've been here before

steps.good: How exciting! I hope you enjoy your visit.

steps.say: Thanks for chatting! Do you know how to say 'thank you' back?

hint.en: Say: Thank you so much for your help!
hint.ru: Скажи: Thank you so much for your help!
hint.vi: Hãy nói: Thank you so much for your help!

steps.good: You're very welcome. Safe travels!

description.en: Chat about your favorite hobbies and how often you do them.
description.ru: Поболтай о своих любимых хобби и о том, как часто ты ими занимаешься.
description.vi: Trò chuyện về sở thích yêu thích của bạn và tần suất bạn thực hiện chúng.

steps.say: Hey! What do you usually do in your free time?

hint.en: Say: I usually … (a hobby)
hint.ru: Скажи: I usually … (хобби)
hint.vi: Hãy nói: I usually … (một sở thích)

steps.good: That's a great way to spend your free time!

steps.say: How long have you been doing that hobby?

hint.en: Say: I've been doing it for … years
hint.ru: Скажи: I've been doing it for … years
hint.vi: Hãy nói: I've been doing it for … years

steps.good: Wow, that's a lot of practice and dedication.

steps.say: Do you practice alone or with friends?

hint.en: Say: I practice alone or I practice with friends
hint.ru: Скажи: I practice alone или I practice with friends
hint.vi: Hãy nói: I practice alone hoặc I practice with friends

steps.good: That sounds like the perfect balance.

steps.say: What's the hardest part about your hobby?

hint.en: Say: The hardest part is …
hint.ru: Скажи: The hardest part is …
hint.vi: Hãy nói: The hardest part is …

steps.good: I totally understand, that's never easy.

steps.say: Would you like to try a new hobby someday?

hint.en: Say: Yes, I'd like to try … or No, I'm happy with this one
hint.ru: Скажи: Yes, I'd like to try … или No, I'm happy with this one
hint.vi: Hãy nói: Yes, I'd like to try … hoặc No, I'm happy with this one

steps.good: Sounds exciting! Trying new things is always fun.

steps.say: Thanks for sharing! What hobby should we talk about next time?

hint.en: Say: Let's talk about … next time
hint.ru: Скажи: Let's talk about … next time
hint.vi: Hãy nói: Let's talk about … next time

steps.good: Perfect, I can't wait to hear about that.

description.en: Practice trying on clothes and talking about sizes and colors in a store.
description.ru: Потренируйся примерять одежду и говорить о размерах и цветах в магазине.
description.vi: Luyện tập thử quần áo và nói về kích cỡ, màu sắc trong cửa hàng.

steps.say: Hi! Are you looking for anything special today?

hint.en: Say: I'm looking for a … (jacket, shirt, etc.)
hint.ru: Скажи: I'm looking for a … (куртка, рубашка и т.д.)
hint.vi: Hãy nói: I'm looking for a … (áo khoác, áo sơ mi, v.v.)

steps.good: Great, I think we have just the thing.

steps.say: What size do you usually wear?

hint.en: Say: I usually wear size … (small, medium, large)
hint.ru: Скажи: I usually wear size … (S, M, L)
hint.vi: Hãy nói: I usually wear size … (S, M, L)

steps.good: Perfect, let me grab that size for you.

steps.say: What color would you like — do you have a favorite?

hint.en: Say: I like … color, or My favorite color is …
hint.ru: Скажи: I like … color, или My favorite color is …
hint.vi: Hãy nói: I like … color, hoặc My favorite color is …

steps.good: Great choice, that color looks amazing on everyone.

steps.say: Would you like to try it on in the fitting room?

hint.en: Say: Yes, please or No, thank you
hint.ru: Скажи: Yes, please или No, thank you
hint.vi: Hãy nói: Yes, please hoặc No, thank you

steps.good: Sure, the fitting room is right over there.

steps.say: How does it fit — too big, too small, or just right?

hint.en: Say: It fits just right or It's too big / too small
hint.ru: Скажи: It fits just right или It's too big / too small
hint.vi: Hãy nói: It fits just right hoặc It's too big / too small

steps.good: Wonderful, I'm so glad it works well for you.

steps.say: Great! Would you like to pay by card or cash?

hint.en: Say: By card, please or By cash, please
hint.ru: Скажи: By card, please или By cash, please
hint.vi: Hãy nói: By card, please hoặc By cash, please

steps.good: Perfect, thank you so much for shopping with us.

description.en: Chat about today's weather and what you like to do in different seasons.
description.ru: Поболтай о сегодняшней погоде и о том, что ты любишь делать в разные сезоны.
description.vi: Trò chuyện về thời tiết hôm nay và những gì bạn thích làm vào các mùa khác nhau.

steps.say: Good morning! What's the weather like where you are?

hint.en: Say: It's sunny / rainy / cold / hot today
hint.ru: Скажи: It's sunny / rainy / cold / hot today
hint.vi: Hãy nói: It's sunny / rainy / cold / hot today

steps.good: Nice! Thanks for letting me know.

steps.say: Do you like this kind of weather, or do you prefer something else?

hint.en: Say: Yes, I like it or I prefer … weather
hint.ru: Скажи: Yes, I like it или I prefer … weather
hint.vi: Hãy nói: Yes, I like it hoặc I prefer … weather

steps.good: That makes sense, everyone has their favorite.

steps.say: What's your favorite season of the year?

hint.en: Say: My favorite season is … (summer, winter, etc.)
hint.ru: Скажи: My favorite season is … (лето, зима и т.д.)
hint.vi: Hãy nói: My favorite season is … (mùa hè, mùa đông, v.v.)

steps.good: That's a lovely season to enjoy the outdoors.

steps.say: What do you usually wear when it's like this outside?

hint.en: Say: I usually wear a … (jacket, t-shirt, etc.)
hint.ru: Скажи: I usually wear a … (куртка, футболка и т.д.)
hint.vi: Hãy nói: I usually wear a … (áo khoác, áo phông, v.v.)

steps.good: Smart choice, that sounds really comfortable.

steps.say: Does the weather ever change your plans for the day?

hint.en: Say: Yes, sometimes or No, not really
hint.ru: Скажи: Yes, sometimes или No, not really
hint.vi: Hãy nói: Yes, sometimes hoặc No, not really

steps.good: That's a great way to stay flexible and ready.

title.vi: Kể về một ngày ở trường

description.en: Describe a typical school day, your favorite subjects, and how you feel about them.
description.ru: Расскажи о типичном школьном дне, любимых предметах и своих чувствах о них.
description.vi: Mô tả một ngày học điển hình, các môn học yêu thích và cảm nhận của bạn về chúng.

steps.say: Hi! Can you tell me what a typical school day looks like for you?

hint.en: Say: I usually wake up, go to school, and …
hint.ru: Скажи: I usually wake up, go to school, and …
hint.vi: Hãy nói: I usually wake up, go to school, and …

steps.good: That sounds like a busy and full schedule.

steps.say: What's your favorite subject, and why do you enjoy it?

hint.en: Say: My favorite subject is … because …
hint.ru: Скажи: My favorite subject is … because …
hint.vi: Hãy nói: My favorite subject is … because …

steps.good: That's a great subject, and a great reason too.

steps.say: Is there a subject you find difficult, and what makes it hard?

hint.en: Say: I find … difficult because …
hint.ru: Скажи: I find … difficult because …
hint.vi: Hãy nói: I find … difficult because …

steps.good: Thanks for sharing that, it's totally normal to struggle sometimes.

steps.say: How do you usually get to school — walk, bus, or something else?

hint.en: Say: I usually go to school by …
hint.ru: Скажи: I usually go to school by …
hint.vi: Hãy nói: I usually go to school by …

steps.good: Nice, that sounds like a good part of your routine.

steps.say: What do you usually do right after school ends?

hint.en: Say: After school, I usually …
hint.ru: Скажи: After school, I usually …
hint.vi: Hãy nói: After school, I usually …

steps.good: That sounds like a nice way to unwind.

steps.say: If you could change one thing about your school day, what would it be?

hint.en: Say: I would change … because …
hint.ru: Скажи: I would change … because …
hint.vi: Hãy nói: I would change … because …

steps.good: That's a thoughtful idea, thanks for explaining it.

title.vi: Lập kế hoạch cho một chuyến đi

description.en: Talk through the plans, destination, and excitement of an upcoming trip.
description.ru: Обсуди планы, направление и предвкушение будущей поездки.
description.vi: Trò chuyện về kế hoạch, điểm đến và sự háo hức cho một chuyến đi sắp tới.

steps.say: Hey! I heard you're planning a trip. Where would you like to go?

hint.en: Say: I would like to go to … (a place)
hint.ru: Скажи: I would like to go to … (место)
hint.vi: Hãy nói: I would like to go to … (một nơi)

steps.good: What a wonderful place to explore!

steps.say: How long are you planning to stay there?

hint.en: Say: I'm planning to stay for … days/weeks
hint.ru: Скажи: I'm planning to stay for … days/weeks
hint.vi: Hãy nói: I'm planning to stay for … days/weeks

steps.good: That sounds like the perfect amount of time.

steps.say: Who are you traveling with — family, friends, or by yourself?

hint.en: Say: I'm traveling with … or I'm traveling alone
hint.ru: Скажи: I'm traveling with … или I'm traveling alone
hint.vi: Hãy nói: I'm traveling with … hoặc I'm traveling alone

steps.good: That's going to be such a great experience together.

steps.say: What are you most excited to see or do there?

hint.en: Say: I'm most excited to … because …
hint.ru: Скажи: I'm most excited to … because …
hint.vi: Hãy nói: I'm most excited to … because …

steps.good: That sounds absolutely amazing, I'm excited for you.

steps.say: Have you started packing yet, or what do you still need to prepare?

hint.en: Say: I still need to pack … or I've already packed …
hint.ru: Скажи: I still need to pack … или I've already packed …
hint.vi: Hãy nói: I still need to pack … hoặc I've already packed …

steps.good: Good plan, it always helps to prepare early.

steps.say: How do you think this trip will change after you come back?

hint.en: Say: I think I will … after the trip
hint.ru: Скажи: I think I will … after the trip
hint.vi: Hãy nói: I think I will … after the trip

steps.good: That's a beautiful way to think about travel.

steps.say: I hope you have an amazing trip! Anything else you'd like to share?

hint.en: Say: Thank you! I'll tell you all about it when I'm back
hint.ru: Скажи: Thank you! I'll tell you all about it when I'm back
hint.vi: Hãy nói: Thank you! I'll tell you all about it when I'm back

steps.good: Can't wait to hear all about your adventure!
